common.tagline: Enter your website, Sova runs your social media.

landing.metaTitle: Sova · AI that runs your social media
landing.metaDescription: Enter your website and Sova learns your brand, builds a strategy, writes posts and visuals, schedules them on eight networks and learns from the results.
landing.heroTitle: Enter your website, Sova runs your social media.
landing.heroText: Sova learns your brand from your website, builds a strategy, writes posts, creates visuals, schedules and publishes, then learns from the results.
landing.stepsTitle: How it works in three steps
landing.step1Text: Sova extracts your logo, colors, services, tone and audience. You just review and adjust.
landing.step2Text: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, Pinterest and Google Business Profile.
landing.step3Text: Sova publishes at the right time, tracks results and adjusts next month’s plan.
landing.statusNote: The app is in development. Registration opens soon.
landing.trust: 50 free tokens · no card required · Serbian and English
landing.networksText: Sova publishes through official APIs, with your approval or automatically.
landing.f1Text: Reads your website and extracts services, tone, audience, colors and facts it then uses in every post.
landing.f2Text: Copy tailored to each network, images and template visuals, translation and hashtags.
landing.f3Text: Drafts, comments, a client approval link and on-time publishing, even when you change time zones.
landing.f4Text: A weekly plan from your strategy, with quality checks, a token budget and approval deadlines.
landing.f5Text: Reach, engagement and best times per network, with weekly insights on what to change.
landing.f6Text: Multiple brands in one workspace, roles, invitations and per-client approvals.
landing.pricingText: Tokens are used only when AI creates something. Publishing and the calendar are free.
landing.planFreeText: 50 tokens to try, one brand and two networks.
landing.planMonthlyText: tokens every month, up to 3 brands, 10 networks and 3 members.
landing.planYearlyText: tokens every month, paid yearly in advance.
landing.a1: Tokens are the unit of AI work: post copy costs 2, an image 8, a strategy 20. Failed generations are never charged.
landing.a2: Only if you choose so. Autopilot has levels: suggestions, drafts for approval, or publishing within rules you set.
landing.a3: Yes, any time, in billing settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
landing.a4: Network tokens are encrypted, and you can export your data or delete your account at any time.
landing.a5: Serbian (Latin and Cyrillic) and English, in the tone and form of address Sova learns from your website.
landing.ctaText: Enter your website and get a brand profile, a strategy and your first posts within minutes.
landing.yearlySaving: About {perMonth} per month, {percent}% less than the monthly plan.
